subject: POC trial planning + RACI / stakeholder mapping - Northbridge Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@northbridgehealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + POC success criteria / next steps

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the POC: 

1) Success criteria (proposed)
- Integration: Redwood API integrated with patient-search service and returns normalized summaries for top-5 queries with <= 2s median latency.
- Accuracy: Clinical summary quality rated >= 4/5 by your clinical SME on a 10-case evaluation set.
- Security: Data never leaves Northbridge VPC; audit logs available for review.
- Cost envelope: Average token cost meets the budget target we discussed ($0.003 / token or below with batching + caching).

2) Evaluation plan / timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, share RACI, exchange access requirements (network/firewall rules, test dataset).
- Week 1: Integration + basic smoke tests.
- Week 2: Structured eval with 10-case sample; clinical review.
- Week 3: Performance run (load test), cost estimate, and decision checkpoint.

3) Ownership / RACI (initial draft - please confirm)
- Infra/network: Northbridge infra (Priya Suresh) — Responsible
- App integration: Northbridge app team (Alex) — Responsible/Collaborate with Redwood eng (Aditya)
- Security & compliance: Northbridge security (security@northbridgehealth.org) — Accountable for sign-off; Redwood (Lauren) — Consulted/Support
- Procurement / commercial: Northbridge procurement — Responsible for contract & PO; Marissa — Accountable for Redwood side

4) Next steps (action items)
- Alex: Share contact for procurement + test dataset (action: by Tue EOD).
- Priya: Send firewall rules and KMS/keys requirements (action: Tue).
- Aditya: Drop integration checklist + sample curl examples (action: Mon morning).
- Marissa: Send RACI spreadsheet + draft SOW and PO guidance (action: Mon afternoon).

Attachments: NB_PO_Criteria_v1.xlsx (proposed success criteria table) — attached.

If this looks right, we’ll lock the dates and get the technical kickoff on Wednesday.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
https://redwoodinference.com

--

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + POC success criteria / next steps

Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: Agreement in principle. One ask: can we expand the evaluation sample to 20 cases (10 clinical + 10 ops) to cover edge cases?
- Timeline: Tight but doable; procurement and security approvals are the usual gating items for us.

RACI updates / stakeholders (confirming):
- Infra / network: Priya Suresh (Director, Cloud Infra) — Responsible for VPC peering, firewall, KMS notes.
- App integration: Alex (me) / Michael Grant (lead engineer) — Responsible for integration work.
- Security / compliance: Dr. Erin Park (security@northbridgehealth.org) — Accountable for SOC2/data flow sign-off.
- Clinical SME: Dr. Lina Morales — Responsible for accuracy review.
- Procurement: procurement@northbridgehealth.org — Responsible for PO & master services agreement (MSA).

Actions:
- I’ll share the procurement contact and an anonymized 20-case sample by Tue 10/20.
- Priya will send firewall rules and KMS notes by Tue as well.

One question for Redwood: for the audit logs and retention, can you confirm if logs can be forwarded to our Splunk instance? Also need a short note on how tokenization affects PHI leakage risk (even high level) for my security team.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Product Integration | Northbridge Health
alex.johnson@northbridgehealth.org | (617) 555-0100
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@northbridgehealth.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + POC success criteria / next steps

Alex — great meeting. Quick answers to your questions: 

- Logs: Yes — Redwood can forward audit logs via secure syslog/S3 export to your Splunk ingestion (we’ll provide the connector details). We’ll include a short architecture diagram in the onboarding pack.
- PHI/tokenization: High level: Redwood never sends raw model inputs to third parties. We support customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest and ensure that PII/PHI is covered by our data handling controls. For the eval, we recommend using de-identified test cases (we can provide a template). I’ll draft a 1-page security note for Dr. Morales.

I’m attaching a RACI template spreadsheet (Northbridge_RACI_template.xlsx) with the internal/external owners prefilled based on today’s call — please review and drop any edits.

Aditya — I left the integration checklist in the shared drive; can you paste the curl examples and token steps into the checklist by EOD?

Marissa — feel free to share the SOW draft after you send your procurement guidance.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
